utterances.text: Hello there! How was your day?
Hey Grandpa! My day was pretty good, just busy with schoolwork.
That's great to hear! How do you find driving it?
Driving is going well, but I'm still a bit nervous about parking.
I'm glad you're enjoying it. If you ever need any tips, just let me know.
Thanks, Grandpa! I might take you up on that offer soon.
Oh, I see. Well, I'm here if you need anything.
I appreciate it, Grandpa. I'll definitely ask if I need help.
Alright, just let me know if you need anything or want to chat.
Will do, Grandpa! Thanks again for being there for me.
Yes, he's still here. Do you want to talk to him?
Sure, I'd love to talk to him!
You're welcome! Let me know if you need anything else.
Thanks, Grandpa! I'll let you know if I need anything.
I'm glad to help. If you ever need anything, just reach out.
I really appreciate it, Grandpa. You're the best!
Great, I'm here if you need anything else.
Thanks again, Grandpa. I'll definitely reach out if I need anything.
Wow, it sounds like you've got quite a catch there! How many do you think there are?
I'm not sure, but it looks like there are quite a few! Maybe around ten or so?
That's impressive! Catching a needlefish is quite a feat, even if it got away. Keep up the great work!
Thanks, Grandpa! I'll keep practicing and hopefully catch one next time.
Fishing can be quite the adventure, can't it? I'm proud of you for trying your best.
Yeah, it really is! Thanks for always supporting me, Grandpa.
I'm sorry if it seemed that way. I know you're working hard and I appreciate your effort.
No worries, Grandpa. I know you mean well and I appreciate it.
A big trout, that's fantastic! You're really making the most of this trip.
Thanks, Grandpa! I'm really enjoying it and learning a lot.
Wow, five keepers! That's really impressive. You're doing an amazing job out there.
